SPIRETALK-TEMPERAMENT.title: Temperament
SPIRETALK-MSG.SourceHintOpenRouter: One key covers every model in the list. Sign up at OpenRouter, add credit, then create a key on its Keys page and paste it here.
SPIRETALK-MSG.SourceHintOllama: Runs on your own graphics card: free, no key. Install Ollama and pull a model first; replies get slow when another program is using the GPU.
SPIRETALK-MSG.SourceHintCustom: OpenAI, DeepSeek and anything else that speaks the OpenAI API. Enter its endpoint (usually ending in /v1) and key, then press Test to list its models.
SPIRETALK-MSG.ModelsUnavailableOllama: Can't reach Ollama on this PC. Start Ollama, then reopen this page.
SPIRETALK-MSG.ModelsUnavailableCustom: No model list yet. Fill in the endpoint and key and press Test, or pick Other and type the model ID.
SPIRETALK-MSG.MemorySubtitle: What each of them remembers is up to you
SPIRETALK-MSG.MemoryNotesHint: {0} reads these before every conversation. Fix what is wrong, delete what is not needed, or add your own, e.g. “The climber's name is Ash and they hate spiders.”
SPIRETALK-MSG.MemoryLogHint: Only the visit in progress goes to the model word for word; older visits have become the notes above and their wording is no longer sent.
SPIRETALK-MSG.MemoryForgetDone: Forgotten. Affection and keepsake marks are kept.
